tasks.text: Mirror the part according to the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part. Merge the mirrored part together with the existing one so they create one body.
Make the whole frame structure taller by 0,5cm. The area profile remains the same.
Add two horizontal buttons to the front panel. One above existing one, the other below - all approximately equally distanced. Buttons should be copies of existing one.

If edge with bigger radius is considered as top, add supporting structure to the bottom of the frame by offseting inner wall by 2cm with thickness of 0,5cm of the supporting structure all around. This will create step at the bottom of the frame, enlarging bottom surface area. Leave out radii at the bottom edges. Add radii from top, 0,2cm which will create smoothe transition from above. Bottom remains flat.
Add two click buttons with the height of 2 millimetre to provide a comfortable and responsive feel for the user

Add rectangular openining to the lower back of the coffee machine, which might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch. Opening should be 20cm x 10cm and 3cm deep rectangle with roundend corners (radius 1cm). Position should be more or less equally distanced from bottom and sides of the device.
